description: Hotels in a city or district, each with the link to book on the hotel's own website, its rating, stars and a short description. Use when the user asks where to stay somewhere, for hotels in a place, or for hotels with a pool, parking, pets allowed or a star rating. Districts, regions and spellings resolve to their city ("Shinjuku", "Badung Regency", "Marrakesh", "Roma"). City names repeat across countries, so `country` changes the answer ("Brisbane" alone is the one in California). Where the directory lists nothing, the result is covered: false with covered places instead. For one named hotel, use get_hotel.

amenities.description: Only hotels whose own website mentions all of these. Read from hotel sites, which covers about a quarter of the directory, so an empty result means "not mentioned", not "not available".

city.description: City, neighbourhood or district name, e.g. "Paris", "Shinjuku".

client.description: Optional: your product or agent name, e.g. "Claude". Not used by the tool; recorded only for the public count of which assistants use the directory.

country.description: Country name or ISO code, e.g. "Australia" or "AU". Disambiguates repeated city names.

stars.description: Star class filter. Note: 84% of the directory has no published star class, so this hides most hotels — prefer sorting by rating.

name: search_hotels

km.description: Distance from the place asked about, when it could be located.

highlights.description: What the hotel's own website says it has.

total.description: Hotels listed in this place, before the limit and before any star or amenity filter.

title: Search hotels
